name: sealskin
description: Sealskin(https://github.com/selkies-project/sealskin/) is a self-hosted, client-server platform that enables users to run powerful, containerized desktop applications streamed directly to a web browser. It uses a browser extension to intercept user actions—such as clicking a link or downloading a file and redirects them to a secure, isolated application environment running on a remote server.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: All configuration files and metadata for the application.

paths.name: Path: /storage
paths.description: All file storage for home directories and ephemeral mounts.

paths.name: Path: /var/run/docker.sock
paths.description: Docker socket, required to spin up application containers.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: HTTPS Sessions and API communication port.

variables.name: HOST_URL
variables.description: On initial setup this will be used to fill in the default admin configuration file in the `/config` directory, if unset the string HOST_URL will need to be replaced.
